description_en: Network-wide ads & trackers blocking DNS server
readme_excerpt: Privacy protection center for you and your devices Free and open source, powerful network-wide ads & trackers blocking DNS server. AdGuard.com | Wiki | Reddit | Twitter | Telegram AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads and tracking. After you set it up, it'll cover ALL your home devices, and you don't need any client-side software for that.
